name: FCC 204 (Hubble)
blurb: FCC 204, a dwarf lenticular galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc204-hubble
story: A small early-type galaxy belonging to the Fornax Cluster, one of 43 such galaxies Hubble surveyed to study the globular clusters around them and to calibrate a way of measuring cosmic distances.

claims.text: FCC 204 (also ESO358-G43) is a dwarf S0 (dwarf lenticular) galaxy at 03 38 13.60 -33 07 31.29
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey imaged 43 early-type galaxies in the Fornax cluster
Fornax is a cluster of galaxies
The survey measured the globular clusters of these galaxies and calibrated the surface brightness fluctuation distance method
The observations were HST program GO 10217
